description: This file is a PHP view template for managing FAQ entries in an admin interface. It generates HTML with embedded PHP to display, filter, edit, move, translate, and delete FAQ items, utilizing external data and linking to various admin actions.

classes.name: faq
classes.description: Objects representing individual FAQ entries, containing properties such as id, title, and order.

methods.name: addFaq
methods.description: Functionality for adding a new FAQ entry, linked via the 'Añadir pregunta' button.

methods.name: editFaq
methods.description: Functionality for editing an existing FAQ, accessible via the '[Editar]' link.

methods.name: moveFaqUp
methods.description: Move a FAQ up in order, triggered by the '[↑]' link.

methods.name: moveFaqDown
methods.description: Move a FAQ down in order, triggered by the '[↓]' link.

methods.name: translateFaq
methods.description: Translate a FAQ entry, available if user has translator role, via the '[Traducir]' link.

methods.name: removeFaq
methods.description: Remove a FAQ entry, with confirmation prompt, triggered by '[Quitar]' link.
